OutCycling Weekly Park Laps

New York, NY · Road

LGBTQ+Unconfirmed — check with the host

OutCycling Weekly Park Laps is a road group ride in New York, NY. Schedule: Weekly lap sessions in Central Park and Prospect Park, spring through fall; dates and times posted in the club's Spond group. Pace: green 12–16 mph, Red 16–20 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @outcyclingny the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the OutCycling Weekly Park Laps group ride

New York's largest LGBTQ+ cycling club runs weekly park laps for building fitness plus over 150 rides a year, with a lead and a sweep on hosted rides. Two tiers, recreational and advanced. Rides require sign-up in Spond, so join first.
